description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) HONOURED INTERRED (Might of the Moritoi, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (Shooting phase); P2 has 0 CP (no Ork reactions). No window ('Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase'): the player real-clicks the S button, HONOURED INTERRED's Use button, then the Contemptor-Achillus in the unit picker (1 CP). Effect: friendly Custodes within 6" of it re-roll hit rolls of 1 (Custodian Guard B, 4" away), not units further away (Prosecutors); Custodian Guard B then shoots the Nobz with the aura (hit-roll 1s re-rolled).

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined

the Game Log names the stratagem
